name: copy-tab-link
title: Copy Tab Link
description: Copy the current browser tab as a clickable rich text link for Teams, Outlook or Word, or in Markdown, HTML, Slack, Jira, AsciiDoc and more. Works with Arc, Chrome, Safari, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi, Opera, Orion and Firefox, cleans tracking parameters and tidies up page titles.
author: jnbp

commands.name: copy-rich-text-link
commands.title: Copy Tab as Rich Text Link
commands.subtitle: Copy Tab Link
commands.description: Copies the current tab as a formatted link, ready to paste into Teams, Outlook, Word or any rich text field.

commands.name: paste-rich-text-link
commands.title: Paste Tab as Rich Text Link
commands.subtitle: Copy Tab Link
commands.description: Pastes the current tab as a formatted link straight into the field you were typing in.

commands.name: copy-plain-link
commands.title: Copy Tab as Plain Text
commands.subtitle: Copy Tab Link
commands.description: Copies the current tab as plain text in the shape you configured, for example the bare URL or Title — URL.

commands.name: copy-custom-link
commands.title: Copy Tab in Custom Format
commands.subtitle: Copy Tab Link
commands.description: Copies the current tab using your own template.

commands.name: copy-tab-as
commands.title: Copy Tab as…
commands.subtitle: Copy Tab Link
commands.description: Pick a format from a list with a live preview, then copy or paste it.

commands.name: copy-all-tabs
commands.title: Copy All Tabs
commands.subtitle: Copy Tab Link
commands.description: Copies every tab of the frontmost browser window as a list.

preferences.name: browserSource
preferences.title: Read the Current Tab From
preferences.description: AppleScript works without any extra install. The Raycast browser extension also covers Firefox and Zen.

preferences.name: preferredBrowser
preferences.title: Preferred Browser
preferences.description: Always read the tab from this browser instead of whichever app is in front.

preferences.name: richTextMethod
preferences.title: Rich Text Method
preferences.description: How the formatted link is put on the clipboard. Automatic offers RTF, HTML and plain text at once, which covers Teams, Outlook and Word as well as browsers. Pick RTF only if an app still refuses the link.

data.title: Automatic — RTF, HTML and plain text together
RTF only — the safest bet for Teams, Outlook, Word
HTML only — for browsers, Notion and other web apps

preferences.name: richTextFallback
preferences.title: Rich Text Fallback
preferences.description: What lands on the clipboard for apps that cannot handle formatted text.

preferences.name: plainFormat
preferences.title: Plain Text Format
preferences.description: Used by the Copy Tab as Plain Text command.

data.title: Title, URL on the next line

preferences.name: titleUrlSeparator
preferences.title: Title and URL Separator
preferences.description: Sits between the title and the URL in the plain text formats.

preferences.name: allTabsFormat
preferences.title: Format for All Tabs
preferences.description: Which format the Copy All Tabs command uses for each line.

preferences.name: allTabsPrefix
preferences.title: List Style for All Tabs
preferences.description: Whether each line starts with a bullet, a number, or nothing at all.

preferences.name: stripTracking
preferences.title: URL Cleanup
preferences.label: Remove tracking parameters
preferences.description: Strips campaign and click-id parameters from the URL before copying.

preferences.name: trackingParams
preferences.title: Tracking Parameters
preferences.description: Comma-separated. A trailing asterisk matches a prefix, for example utm_*.
preferences.default: utm_*, fbclid, gclid, gbraid, wbraid, msclkid, dclid, twclid, ttclid, yclid, igshid, mc_cid, mc_eid, _hsenc, _hsmi, vero_id, wickedid, si, spm, ref_src, oly_enc_id, oly_anon_id

preferences.name: removeFragment
preferences.title: Fragment
preferences.label: Remove everything after the # in the URL
preferences.description: Cuts off the #section part at the end of the address.

preferences.name: stripSiteSuffix
preferences.title: Title Cleanup
preferences.label: Remove a trailing site name, for example " | Example Corp"
preferences.description: Many pages append their own name to the title. This removes it.

preferences.name: titlePatterns
preferences.title: Title Patterns
preferences.description: Regular expressions removed from the title, separated by ;; — for example \s*[-|] Google Docs$;;^\(\d+\)\s*

preferences.name: stripEmoji
preferences.title: Emoji
preferences.label: Remove emoji from the title
preferences.description: Some sites put an emoji in front of the page title.

preferences.name: maxTitleLength
preferences.title: Maximum Title Length
preferences.description: Shortens longer titles with an ellipsis. Leave empty for no limit.

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action in Copy Tab As…
preferences.description: What the Enter key does in the Copy Tab As list.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
